title: Celestial Body Taxonomy
description: Taxonomy schema for classifying celestial bodies in the Solar System. Defines a strict hierarchy with required metadata fields.

items.title: Celestial Body Entry
items.description: A single celestial body entry with its taxonomic classification and physical metadata.

category.description: Top-level classification of the celestial body.

sub_category.description: Sub-classification within the top-level category (e.g., 'Terrestrial', 'Gas Giant', 'Ice Giant', 'Asteroid', 'Comet', 'Kuiper Belt Object', 'Moon').

name.description: Official IAU name of the celestial body.

mass_kg.description: Mass of the celestial body in kilograms. Must be a positive number.

orbital_period_days.description: Orbital period around the primary body in Earth days. Must be a positive number.

composition_type.description: Primary bulk composition type. 'silicate' for rocky/metallic bodies, 'ice' for icy bodies, 'gas' for gas-dominated bodies.
